instruction.text: Read the two texts and compare them to answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Craft Book Instructions:
Making dream catchers is fun and easy, and you get a great addition to your room at the end! You start with a craft ring, thread, beads and feathers. Simply wind the thread around the hoop in many directions in patterns that please you. Then, take the thread and cut several smaller pieces. Add feathers and beads as you like to the single pieces and simply tie to the bottom of the dream catcher so that they dangle. Now you have finished your project!

atoms.text:
Cecilia’s Experience:
How did the thread get so tangled? I am spending more time untying knots than wrapping it in pretty shapes. The beads won’t stay on my thread because my knots are too small and the beads keep slipping off. I don’t like these feathers anymore, they’re not big enough, and I also made them look bad by touching them too much. This looked so easy and fun!
